description: Phase 0E for RSI_1h_edge_discovery: lower 1h ATR symmetric ruler sweep after wide 3-4x 1h ATR rails were judged too continuation-like for EMA200 pullback semantics.
notes: Phase 0D showed that 3-4x 1h ATR rails can produce high PnL, but they may be too wide for EMA200 pullback semantics on a 5m chart.
The concern is that 3-4x 1h ATR stop/take can exceed anchor-stack width and sometimes place stops far beyond the EMA pullback structure.
This Phase 0E intentionally searches the lower ruler zone from 0.75 to 2.50 with step 0.05.
2.50 is included only as an upper comparator; the target is to find a stable, interpretable lower ruler, not to maximize continuation holding.
No RSI blocker, RSI gate, ADX runner, runtime exits, BE, partial TP, trailing, HTF context, or asymmetric rails are included.

metadata.note: Lower sweep intentionally avoids 3-4x 1h ATR wide-continuation zone.
